# Load packages

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratWrappers)
library(tidyverse)
library(Biobase)
library(BiocGenerics)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(msigdbr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(circlize)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(CellChat)
library(UCell)
```



# Load data

```{r, include=FALSE}
load("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/sc_combined_subclusters.RData")
```



# Subset scRNAseq for KPP and KIC tumour-bearing muscle

```{r, include=FALSE}
rm(all_genes, Agca_snLLC_CTL, Agca_snLLC_LLC, Brown_scLLC_CTL, Brown_scLLC_2w, Brown_scLLC_2.5w, Brown_scLLC_3.5w, Kim_scB16F10_CTL, Kim_scB16F10_B16F10, Pryce_scC26_CTL, Pryce_scC26_C26, Pryce_scKPP_CTL, Pryce_scKPP_KPP, Zhang_snKIC_CTL, Zhang_snKIC_KIC, DEGs_sc_combined)

Idents(sc_combined) <- "experiment"

KPP_KIC_model <- subset(sc_combined, idents = c("Pryce_scKPP", "Zhang_snKIC"))

rm(sc_combined)
```



# Read in the list of receptors that match ligands from bulkRNAseq of LLC tumours

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPC_receptors <- read.csv("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/tumour_bulk_RNAseq/receptor_lists/KPC_secreted_genes_receptors.csv", header = FALSE)

KPC_receptors <- KPC_receptors[[1]]
```


## Check to see which genes are not present in LLC_model and remove from LLC_receptors

```{r}
KPC_receptors_use <- intersect(KPC_receptors, rownames(KPP_KIC_model))

not_in_model <- setdiff(KPC_receptors, rownames(KPP_KIC_model))

not_in_model

rm(not_in_model, KPC_receptors)
```



# Run GO terms on all receptors picking up signals from tumours

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPP_KIC_model_go <- enrichGO(gene = KPC_receptors_use, OrgDb = "org.Mm.eg.db", keyType = "SYMBOL", ont = "BP")
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
write.csv(KPP_KIC_model_go, file = "go_KPP_KIC_receptors_use.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```


## Visualize top 10 GO terms

```{r}
KPP_KIC_model_go_top10 <- KPP_KIC_model_go[1:10, ]

ggplot(KPP_KIC_model_go_top10, aes(x = FoldEnrichment, 
                           y = reorder(Description, FoldEnrichment),
                           size = Count, 
                           color = p.adjust)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red", name = "adj. p-value") +
  labs(x = "Fold Enrichment", y = NULL, 
       title = "UP GO KPP/KIC muscle receptors") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")
  )
```



# Run KEGG pathway analysis on the receptors that are upregulated in tumour-bearing muscle

### Get DEGs in cachectic subcluster

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(KPP_KIC_model) <- "orig.ident"

DEGs_KPP_KIC_model <- FindMarkers(KPP_KIC_model, ident.1 = c("Pryce_scKPP_KPP", "Zhang_snKIC_KIC"), ident.2 = c("Pryce_scKPP_CTL", "Zhang_snKIC_CTL"), logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)
```

### Subset DEG for p_val_adj < 0.05 and avg_log2FC > 0.2 and in KPC_receptors_use

```{r}
DEGs_KPP_KIC_model <- subset(DEGs_KPP_KIC_model, p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC > 0.2)

DEGs_KPP_KIC_model <- DEGs_KPP_KIC_model[rownames(DEGs_KPP_KIC_model) %in% KPC_receptors_use,
]

rownames(DEGs_KPP_KIC_model)
```

### KEGG pathway analysis

```{r, include=FALSE}
### Convert gene symbols to Entrez IDs
DEGs_KPP_KIC_model_gene_names <- rownames(DEGs_KPP_KIC_model)

DEGs_KPP_KIC_model_IDs <- bitr(DEGs_KPP_KIC_model_gene_names,
                  fromType = "SYMBOL",
                  toType   = "ENTREZID",
                  OrgDb    = org.Mm.eg.db)

DEGs_KPP_KIC_model_kegg <- enrichKEGG(
  gene         = DEGs_KPP_KIC_model_IDs$ENTREZID,
  organism     = "mmu",
  keyType      = "kegg",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05
)

write.csv(DEGs_KPP_KIC_model_kegg, file = "kegg_KPC_receptors_use.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```

### Visualize KEGG pathways

```{r}
KPP_KIC_signaling_pathways <- c(1:60)
KPP_KIC_kegg_signaling <- DEGs_KPP_KIC_model_kegg[KPP_KIC_signaling_pathways, ]

KPP_KIC_kegg_signaling$Description <- gsub(" - Mus musculus \\(house mouse\\)$", "", KPP_KIC_kegg_signaling$Description)

ggplot(KPP_KIC_kegg_signaling, aes(x = FoldEnrichment, 
                           y = reorder(Description, FoldEnrichment),
                           size = Count, 
                           color = p.adjust)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red", name = "adj. p-value") +
  labs(x = "Fold Enrichment", y = NULL, 
       title = "UP KEGG KPP/KIC muscle") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")
  )
```



# Remove unused objects

```{r, include=FALSE}
rm(DEGs_KPP_KIC_model, DEGs_KPP_KIC_model_IDs, DEGs_KPP_KIC_model_gene_names, DEGs_KPP_KIC_model_kegg, kegg_category, KPP_KIC_kegg_signaling, KPP_KIC_model_go, KPP_KIC_model_go_top10, KPP_KIC_signaling_pathways)
```



# Score cells for receptor expression

```{r, include=FALSE}
KPC_receptors_score <- AddModuleScore_UCell(KPP_KIC_model, features = list(KPC_receptors_use), name = "KPC_receptors_score")

means_KPC_receptors_score <- KPC_receptors_score@meta.data %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters) %>%
  summarise(average_KPC_receptors_score = mean(signature_1KPC_receptors_score, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
print(means_KPC_receptors_score)
```

```{r}
cluster_colours <- c(
    "Satellite cells"      = "#FF7FBF",
    "Myoblasts"            = "#FF3F80",
    "Myonuclei"            = "#E00000",
    "Endothelial cells"    = "#FFFF00",
    "vSMCs"                = "#BC9D00",
    "Pericytes"            = "#8B5A2B",
    "FAPs"                 = "#7CFC00",
    "Tenocytes"            = "#228B22",
    "Platelets"            = "#D46A6A", 
    "Mast cells"           = "#C85C8C", 
    "Dendritic cells"      = "#B84D9E", 
    "Monocytes"            = "#80E5FF",
    "Macrophages"          = "#1E90FF",
    "Neutrophils"          = "#4169E1",
    "B cells"              = "#C9A2FF",
    "T cells"              = "#B44CFF",
    "NK cells"             = "#5B0E8A",
    "Neural/glial cells"   = "#FF7F00",
    "Schwann cells"        = "#FFA64D" 
)

VlnPlot(KPC_receptors_score, features = "signature_1KPC_receptors_score", group.by = "seurat_clusters", pt.size = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_colours) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "LLC receptors score", title = NULL) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "black")
```

```{r}
FeaturePlot(
  KPC_receptors_score, features = "signature_1KPC_receptors_score", reduction = "umap") +
  labs(color = "KPC receptors score") +
  theme(plot.title = element_blank())
```

# What receptor genes are upregulated in cachectic endothelial cells, vSMCs, pericytes in the muscle?

### Subset for endothelial cells, vSMCs, pericytes

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(KPP_KIC_model) <- "seurat_clusters"

KPP_KIC_model_ECs_vSMCs_pericytes <- subset(KPP_KIC_model, idents = c("Endothelial cells", "vSMCs", "Pericytes"))
```

### DEGs in tumour-bearing endothelial cells, vSMCs, pericytes

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(KPP_KIC_model_ECs_vSMCs_pericytes) <- "orig.ident"

DEGs_KPP_KIC_model_ECs_vSMCs_pericytes <- FindMarkers(KPP_KIC_model_ECs_vSMCs_pericytes, ident.1 = c("Pryce_scKPP_KPP", "Zhang_snKIC_KIC"), ident.2 = c("Pryce_scKPP_CTL", "Zhang_snKIC_CTL"), logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)
```

### Subset DEGs for p_val_adj < 0.05, avg_log2FC > 0.2, included in LLC_receptors_use

```{r}
DEGs_KPP_KIC_model_ECs_vSMCs_pericytes <- subset(DEGs_KPP_KIC_model_ECs_vSMCs_pericytes, p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC > 0.2)

DEGs_KPP_KIC_model_ECs_vSMCs_pericytes <- DEGs_KPP_KIC_model_ECs_vSMCs_pericytes[
    rownames(DEGs_KPP_KIC_model_ECs_vSMCs_pericytes) %in% KPC_receptors_use,
]

rownames(DEGs_KPP_KIC_model_ECs_vSMCs_pericytes)
```
